examples.title: Title of the window that lists the saved response examples of a request.
examples.servedByDefault: Accessible label of a star that marks the example the mock server returns by default.
examples.serveByDefault: Accessible label of the button that makes this example the default of the mock server.
examples.format: Accessible label of the button that indents the example body.
examples.section: Accessible label of the Body or Headers switch.
examples.body: Tab of the example window: the body of the example.
examples.headersCount: Tab with the number of headers. {{count}} is that number.
examples.noContentType: Shown instead of the content type when the example has none.
examples.discard: Button that throws away unsaved edits of the example body.
examples.saveBody: Button that saves the edited example body.
examples.bodyTooLarge: {{size}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as 2.50 MB.
